title: A Framework for Exploring the Consequences of AI-Mediated Enterprise Knowledge Access and Identifying Risks to Workers

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptually analyzed through the framework's 'Systematic Reproduction' mechanism, examining how enterprise AI systems can perpetuate historical marginalization and exclusionary norms due to underrepresentation in training data.
Conceptually evaluated via the 'Demographic Blindness' mechanism, analyzing how treating workers uniformly ignores variations in dialects and sociolects, leading to disparities in system outcomes.

Conceptually identified as a risk stemming from organizational power asymmetries and training data imbalances, resulting in enterprise systems working better for dominant geographic regions and languages.

Conceptually examined through 'Bias Amplification', illustrating how pre-existing demographic biases (e.g., in expert identification) are exacerbated by system features like exposure bias and ranked lists.
